title: Signal: Set-Cookie Expires date exceeds the 400-day browser cap
scope: One Set-Cookie value whose Expires date falls in 2030 or later.
limitations: One Set-Cookie value. The check reads the declared year; it does not clamp the value the way a specific browser would, and it does not decide whether a long-lived cookie is acceptable for that data.

headers.Set-Cookie: sid=abc; Expires=Wed, 01 Jan 2099 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; Secure
sid=abc; Expires=Fri, 01 Jan 2027 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; Secure

fpNotes: A cookie whose expiry is inside the cap is not reported; the Max-Age form of the same defect is reported by DPK-DAST-281, so this rule reads only Expires.
